adaptations: Renamed ruby-upgrade to upgrade-ruby, including its heading, announcement, and internal path examples.
Added explicit invocation metadata, a human-facing description, and Rails Kit packaging.
Replaced unavailable upstream Rails upgrade routing with the local upgrade-rails skill and removed the unavailable verification skill reference while retaining its passing-output requirement.
Made current official Ruby documentation authoritative over the imported detection inventory.
Imported both upstream source files and preserved the upstream MIT notice; recorded the approved workflow and technical corrections below.

changes.R1: Handle explicit and file-backed Ruby constraints; verify the selected interpreter before lockfile updates and inside the bundle.
changes.R2: Scope the inventory to the actual version transition, include RubyGems/Bundler migration checks, and distinguish compatibility defects from optional changes.
changes.R3: Support a direct audit when subagents are unavailable and cite official sources with stable entry identifiers instead of assumed report paths.
changes.R4: Diagnose native-extension failures before proposing a confirmed, targeted restore or cache invalidation; remove automatic recursive deletion.

verification_fixes.F1: Limit the existing-pin restriction to version-pin edits; permit confirmed compatibility changes in existing files without Ruby pins.
verification_fixes.F2: Inspect require arguments across quote styles, parentheses, and multiline calls; retain dynamic-require coverage gaps and bundle checks.
verification_fixes.F3: Use verified Markdown variants of the Ruby 4.0 release notes and Ruby directive documentation.
